This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce stress, improve cardiovascular health, and boost the immune system. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Christella microbasis, but its potential uses in traditional medicine make it an interesting area of study.
